# 2 Clement — Chapter 20 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 20
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Do not let the evil one take satisfaction in having power over you. Brothers, you do not need to be overwhelmed by the fact that this present time is full of hard work, heat, worry, and suffering.
2. You have come to God as his children, not as strangers. So when you hear that he is coming, do not be afraid.
3. The good shepherd left ninety-nine sheep on the mountains and went looking for the one that had wandered off. When he found it, he was happier about it than about the ninety-nine.
4. Our Savior feels the same way — he wills that not one of the righteous be lost. He is calling all of us, brothers, to repentance through his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord. To him be glory and power forever and ever. Amen.

---

*[Closing doxology from Codex Hierosolymitanus:]*

5. To the only invisible God — the Father of truth, who sent us the Savior and author of immortality — through whom he revealed to us the truth and the life of heaven: to him be glory forever and ever. Amen.
